newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 5.061 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 5.061 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended March 29 was 5,061,642 gallons compared with 4,724,212 gallons last week.
Imports were 349,555 gallons compared with 2,631,557 gallons the previous week. There were 13,448 domestic receipts for this week compared with 80,782 the previous week.
Retail movement was 1,088,442 gallons, while bulk movement was 3,515,892 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 91,120,718 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 168,641,211 gallons.
